summary: The proposed expectation correction is independently justified; no valid requirement is waived. doc/random-policy.md’s Exact sampling contract explicitly permits pass, cancellation, and finishing an empty attacker selection. Neither homogeneous random nor mixed play guarantees an attack. doc/heuristic-policy.md instead requires attacking with every legal attacker. Existing coverage reflects this distinction: crates/mtg-policy/tests/games.rs:424 requires land/cast, while heuristic_games.rs:93 additionally requires nonempty attackers. Retaining all workloads, seeds, repeat/direct comparisons, land/cast checks, and homogeneous heuristic attack coverage preserves requirements coverage; explicit CLI loss predicates strengthen it. This follows RFC0001’s requirement for independently justified expectations, rather than accepting observed implementation output. Approval covers only the proposed correction, including preserving the failing log; it is not implementation verification or final candidate approval.

findings.finding: For added empty_draw checkpoints, check the losing seat’s draw step alongside its empty library, as both existing policy game tests do. doc/terminal.md distinguishes drawing the last card from attempting an empty draw; an empty library alone is only a necessary condition.
